component.name: Reframe
component.summary: Turn raw screen recordings into polished product demos

description.p: Reframe records your screen and then re-frames it: zooms that follow your cursor, wallpapers and gradients behind the window, annotations timed to the frame, and a webcam bubble. Export to MP4, GIF or WebM with no watermark.
Everything happens on your machine — no account, no upload, no telemetry.

ul.li: Auto zoom — cursor movement and clicks are recorded, so zoom keyframes can be suggested at the moments that mattered
Trim, speed ramps and crop, all non-destructive
Annotations with your choice of font, size, colour and placement
Magnify and spotlight, either following the cursor or pinned
Blur or pixelate anything that should not ship
Backgrounds — wallpapers, gradients or solid colours, with padding, roundness and shadow
A smoothed cursor with click highlights, and cursor-hidden recording
Webcam as its own track, placed picture-in-picture, side by side or alone

screenshot.caption: A recording composited on a wallpaper, with the background picker open
Automatically suggested zoom keyframes filling the timeline
A text annotation placed on the video
Exporting to MP4, GIF or WebM

description.p: Fixes exporting longer recordings that include a webcam on Windows, which could fail with a decoding error.

ul.li: Record any screen or window, with system audio, a microphone and a webcam bubble.

Cursor-hidden recording on Linux via a PipeWire screen cast, so the editor's smooth synthetic cursor can stand in — captured from composited frames, so it stays sharp even during fast window switching.
Auto-suggested zooms that follow where your cursor moved and clicked.
Backgrounds, annotations, magnify and spotlight, blur and pixelate, trim and speed ramps — all non-destructive.
Export to MP4, GIF or WebM with no watermark; hardware-accelerated H.264 on macOS and Windows.
Built-in update check, so you're told when a new version is out.
Everything runs on your machine — no account, no upload, no telemetry.
